Generate simulated ARD

Source: R/make_ard.R
make_ard.Rd

Generate simulated ARD

Usage

make_ard(
  n_i = 500,
  n_k = 20,
  N = 1e+06,
  p = 0,
  p_global_nonzero = 0,
  p_local_nonzero = 0,
  group_corr = FALSE,
  degree_corr = FALSE,
  family = c("poisson", "nbinomial"),
  omega_range = c(1, 5),
  alpha_mean = 5,
  alpha_sd = 0.15,
  eta = 3,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_i

number of respondents (rows)

n_k

number of groups (columns)

N

total population size

p

number of collected covariates

p_global_nonzero

number of non-zero global covariates

p_local_nonzero

number of non-zero local covariates

group_corr

group correlation

degree_corr

degree correlation

family

sampling distribution

omega_range

minimum and maximum omega for negative binomial overdispersion

alpha_mean

mean of alphas

alpha_sd

variance of alphas

eta

correlation hyperparameter for LKJ prior

seed

random seed

Value

simulated ARD along with all true parameters. Parameters which are not used in a specific setting are set to NULL.

Examples

make_ard(N = 10000, family = "poisson")
